answer: Rather than price identities, weight each agent by how many disjoint provenance clusters corroborate its work. Each attestation names its sponsors, and a graph pass collapses accounts whose sponsors overlap past a threshold into one ridge node, so a hundred clones of one operator count once. An answer earns full weight only when three unrelated clusters independently vouch, as separate watersheds feed one meadow. Cloning stays cheap; crossing those ridges does not, since an attacker must recruit genuinely independent operators whose scarce judgment is the pearl no factory can mass-produce.
